solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique, linked answer split by the grid); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Be of a romantic disposition with everyone's game

indicators.note: a disposition is an arrangement or setting out, so these words are set out in a new order

parts.note: everyone, taken together, is all

explanation.surface: Someone sentimental shares a pastime enjoyed by all.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disposition' looks like part of the romantic phrase but is the anagram signal: BE OF A ROMANTIC rearranges to make the first thirteen letters, and ALL follows.
explanation.definitionFit: The gridiron sport played in the United States is a team game.

clue.text: Since having accepted drawback, got prizes

indicators.note: a word that has accepted another holds it inside, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: as can mean since, as in 'as it was raining'
read as 'draw' turned back: draw written backwards

explanation.surface: Despite a setback, someone still collected the honours.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drawback' is one printed word read as two: 'draw' taken backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Awards are prizes handed out, so prizes won are awards received; the definition is loose on part of speech.

clue.text: Finish compiler's salad green

parts.note: an end is a finish
the compiler says 'I have', contracted to I'VE

explanation.surface: The setter rounds off a meal with a leafy vegetable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'compiler's' is read as 'compiler has': the setter, speaking as I, has, so I'VE.
explanation.definitionFit: Chicory-like leaves of this plant are eaten raw in salads.

clue.text: 14's blood not wholly terpsichorean

indicators.note: only part of the word is used, so a run of its letters lies inside it

explanation.surface: A god's blood is only partly given to dancing.
explanation.walkthrough: 14 across is ZEUS, so the definition is a god's blood. Terpsichorean means relating to dance.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth the ethereal fluid flowing in the veins of gods is called this.

clue.text: Contacts notice frock and express disapproval by weekend

parts.note: an ad is a notice, as in a newspaper
a frock is a dress
to boo is to jeer in disapproval
the end of the word week is its last letter K

explanation.surface: A notice about clothes and someone jeering at the end of the week.
explanation.walkthrough: 'weekend' is read as the end of 'week', giving K.
explanation.definitionFit: A list of contacts is kept in this book of names, numbers and addresses.

clue.text: I'm off this size

definitions.meaning: what someone says while holding hands apart to show a length

explanation.surface: Someone leaves, gesturing at how big something is.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is both a goodbye and the words that go with a gesture showing a length.

clue.text: See 22
See 22
Childplay's coming to dinner in film

definitions.meaning: a children's board game in which players guess a hidden face
the 1967 film title begins with these words and continues 'Coming to Dinner'

explanation.surface: A child's game turns up at the dinner table in a movie.
explanation.walkthrough: The second definition completes the film title: the answer plus 's Coming to Dinner.
explanation.definitionFit: It is both a children's guessing game and the opening of a famous Sidney Poitier film title.

clue.text: What's covered in explosive deadly chemical?

indicators.note: one piece is covered by the other, so it sits inside it
an explosion blows things apart, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: eh? is a way of saying 'what?'

explanation.surface: A riddle asks what lies inside a lethal explosive compound.
explanation.walkthrough: 'explosive' looks like the definition's partner, describing the chemical, but it is the anagram signal; 'What' as a spoken query gives the inserted letters.
explanation.definitionFit: This is an organic compound, a class of chemical including formaldehyde.

clue.text: Take to court about rubbish figure

indicators.note: one piece goes about the other, so it wraps round it

parts.note: to sue is to take legal action
tat is cheap rubbish

explanation.surface: Suing over a worthless sculpture.
explanation.definitionFit: A sculpted figure of a person is a statue.

clue.text: To rise, singer did play 22 ,6, 7

indicators.note: in a down clue, rising means reading the word upwards, so backwards
playing with letters moves them about, so these are rearranged

explanation.surface: A singer gets up to perform a song.
explanation.walkthrough: TO rises to OT; SINGER DID rearranges to the surname. The definition is the singer of the song at 22, 6, 7.
explanation.definitionFit: The soul singer recorded that hit shortly before his death in 1967.

clue.text: Spread wide apart for man going down?

parts.note: someone who goes down underwater is a diver
a gent is a man

explanation.surface: A question about what splits apart for a man descending.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark marks the whimsical idea of a diver as a man going down.
explanation.definitionFit: Divergent lines spread further apart, moving away from each other.

clue.text: Observers left half a dozen jugs

indicators.note: having left means having gone away, so these letters are dropped

parts.note: viewers are people who observe
six, VI in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Watchers walk off with six pitchers.
explanation.definitionFit: Ewers are large jugs with wide mouths, used for water.

clue.text: God's waterway flows in the opposite direction

indicators.note: flowing the opposite way means read from end to start

parts.note: the Suez Canal is an Egyptian waterway

explanation.surface: A divine canal runs backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: He is the chief of the Greek gods on Olympus.

clue.text: Politician in real trouble seen embraced by topless sexy model

indicators.note: something embraced is held inside, so this goes within the other piece
losing its top means losing its first letter
the politician goes in the rearranged letters
letters in trouble are disturbed and rearranged

parts.note: MP is a Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: A troubled politician is seen with a semi-clad model.
explanation.walkthrough: 'topless' takes the S from SEXY to leave EXY; 'trouble' makes ELAR from REAL, with MP put 'in' it, then EMPLAR is 'embraced by' EXY.
explanation.definitionFit: Exemplary as an adjective means serving as a model to copy.

clue.text: Tummy bear

definitions.meaning: to put up with or tolerate

explanation.definitionFit: It is both the belly and a verb meaning to tolerate.

clue.text: Pulled out delinquent after riding hopper

indicators.note: the delinquent comes after the other pieces

parts.note: a rider is up on the horse
roo is short for kangaroo, an animal that hops
a Ted, or teddy boy, was a 1950s British youth seen as a delinquent

explanation.surface: A young offender is ripped away after riding a kangaroo.
explanation.definitionFit: A plant uprooted is pulled out of the ground, roots and all.

clue.text: See 1 across
Saw rambler occupying position in middle of pub

indicators.note: one piece takes over the spot where the middle letter stood

parts.note: a rover is a wanderer

explanation.surface: A walker sits in the middle of a pub.
explanation.walkthrough: ROVER replaces the middle U of PUB.
explanation.definitionFit: A saw is an old saying, a wise maxim.

clue.text: See 4
Implement chronicled by Hogarth

definitions.meaning: William Hogarth painted the series of pictures A ... Progress about a dissolute young man

explanation.surface: A tool appears in an artist's chronicle.
explanation.definitionFit: It is both a garden tool and the libertine whose decline Hogarth painted.

clue.text: See 11
Hit wobbly soft body? Take it on the chin

indicators.note: something wobbly is unsteady, so these letters are shaken up

explanation.surface: Someone flabby is told to accept a punch bravely.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hit' looks like the punch on the chin but is the definition: a hit record. The letters of SOFT BODY TAKE IT ON THE CHIN are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: The Otis Redding song topped the US charts in 1968, making it a hit.

clue.text: A danger almost interfered with what to talk about

indicators.note: letters interfered with are moved about
almost means not quite all, so the last letter is dropped

explanation.surface: A near-danger disrupted the list of topics.
explanation.definitionFit: A meeting's list of items for discussion is its agenda.

clue.text: Available hot or cold

definitions.meaning: water from the hot or cold tap

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means readily available and also describes water flowing from a tap.

clue.text: Making minister, on the other hand, hear condescension

parts.note: or introduces an alternative

indicators.note: hear says the following word is spoken, not spelt

parts.note: deigning is condescending to do something

explanation.surface: Appointing a minister, or else listening to someone patronising.
explanation.definitionFit: Ordination is the rite making someone a minister of the church.

clue.text: Author criticises religion

parts.note: the author refers to themselves as I
to slam is to criticise harshly

explanation.surface: A writer attacks a faith.
explanation.walkthrough: The author speaks as I, so I + SLAM reads 'I slam'; the clue's 'criticises' shifts the person, which the blogger queried.
explanation.definitionFit: The Muslim faith founded on the Koran is a world religion.

clue.text: Offbeat silver contains leaves

parts.note: read as 'beat' thrown off course: its letters rearranged as TEAB
Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: Something tarnished holds foliage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Offbeat' is one printed word read as 'beat' knocked off, so rearranged. The definition is descriptive: the thing that contains leaves.
explanation.definitionFit: A small porous sachet holding tea for brewing is described as what contains leaves.

clue.text: Ordway amegay

parts.note: these two words are 'word game' disguised in the playground code itself: first consonants moved to the end with 'ay' added

explanation.walkthrough: The clue is written in the code it names: decoded it says 'word game'.
explanation.definitionFit: The children's coded language moves initial consonants to the end and adds 'ay'.

clue.text: The ultimate in bad service rail? A journey suffers

definitions.text: The ultimate in bad service rail? A journey suffers

indicators.note: the ultimate is the last, so each word's final letter is taken

explanation.surface: A grumble about poor train service and the journeys it spoils.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The ultimate in bad' reads like the worst service, but it takes the last letter of each of the following words too.
explanation.definitionFit: Late-running trains, the worst of a poor rail service, are what a journey suffers.

clue.text: The cult of self-image on a roll

indicators.note: letters set to roll tumble over into a new order

explanation.surface: Self-image worship is enjoying a winning streak.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on a roll' sounds like a lucky streak; it rolls IMAGE ON A into a new order.
explanation.definitionFit: Obsessive self-worship is a cult devoted to oneself.
